items.name: blank
items.title: Blank
items.description: Sets a project up for Blank: the @blank and @blank-pro registries, the light and dark token sheet, and cn().

items.name: theme
items.title: Blank Theme
items.description: Blank's palette, semantic roles for light and dark, Tailwind theme mapping and base layer. Install it once, before any component.

theme.font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Consolas, Menlo, monospace

light.field-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--neutral-900) 5%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 10%, transparent)
light.thumb-shadow: 0 36px 80px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 5%, transparent), 0 13px 29px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 3%, transparent), 0 6px 14px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 3%, transparent), 0 3px 7px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 2%, transparent), 0 1px 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 2%, transparent)
light.tooltip-shadow: 0 3px 10px -2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--neutral-900) 2%, transparent), 0 10px 16px -3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--neutral-900) 5%, transparent)

dark.field-shadow: 0 1px 2px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 30%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 1px color-mix(in oklab, var(--black) 20%, transparent)

items.name: use-hover-capable
items.title: Use Hover Capable
items.description: True only on devices with a real hover (mouse or trackpad), so pointer-follow effects can skip touch screens.

items.name: android-frame
items.title: Android Frame
items.description: A Pixel-style handset drawn in CSS with a punch-hole camera and right-side buttons, at true proportions at any width.

items.name: animated-background
items.title: Animated Background
items.description: A highlight that slides behind the active or hovered item: tabs, menus, segmented controls.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: A curved path between two elements with a beam of light running along it.

items.name: animated-grid-pattern
items.title: Animated Grid Pattern
items.description: A background grid whose cells fade in and out at random.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement
items.description: A pill above a hero headline: an optional tag, a title and an arrow, rendered as a link with asChild.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A page-level announcement strip with actions and a dismiss button.

items.name: bar-list
items.title: Bar List
items.description: Ranked horizontal bars with a label and a formatted value on each row.

items.name: bento-grid
items.title: Bento Grid
items.description: A grid of feature tiles with icon, copy, a background slot and a call to action that rises on hover.

items.name: blur-fade
items.title: Blur Fade
items.description: Fades content in from a blur and a small offset, on mount or on scroll.

items.name: border-beam
items.title: Border Beam
items.description: A short beam of light that travels around an element's border.

items.name: browser-window
items.title: Browser Window
items.description: Browser chrome around a screenshot or a live page, for product visuals.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: A compact, selectable tag with an optional avatar and a dismiss button.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code panel with tabs, line numbers, highlighted lines and a copy button.

items.name: code-window
items.title: Code Window
items.description: Editor chrome with switchable file tabs and numbered lines, with no syntax-highlighting dependency.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: A popover with a saturation area, hue slider, hex/RGB/HSL input, presets and an eyedropper where the browser has one.

items.name: compare-slider
items.title: Compare Slider
items.description: A before/after comparison with a draggable divider, arrow-key control and a vertical option.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copies text to the clipboard and confirms it with an icon morph, a tooltip and a live-region announcement.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: CTA 01
items.description: A centered call-to-action band with a two-tone headline, a primary and a secondary pill button, and a short reassurance line.

items.name: device-stack
items.title: Device Stack
items.description: The hero composition: a MacBook with an iPhone standing in front of one corner, each taking its own screen content.

items.name: dot-pattern
items.title: Dot Pattern
items.description: A dot grid for section backgrounds, with an optional brand-colored glow.

items.name: expandable
items.title: Expandable
items.description: A surface that springs open in place to reveal more content.

items.name: feature-card
items.title: Feature Card
items.description: A marketing card pairing media or an icon with a headline and actions.

items.name: features-01
items.title: Features 01
items.description: A two-tone section heading with a short intro, followed by a six-cell icon grid separated by hairlines. Three columns on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: An accessible file and folder tree with arrow-key navigation, type-ahead, selection and animated folders.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File Upload
items.description: A dropzone with a file list, previews, upload progress, removal and accept/size/count validation.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: A canvas of small squares that flicker, colored from a CSS token.

items.name: footer-01
items.title: Footer 01
items.description: A four-column link footer with a logo, a newsletter field with a subscribed state, a live status link and social icon buttons.

items.name: grid-pattern
items.title: Grid Pattern
items.description: A static SVG grid for section backgrounds, with optional highlighted cells.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero 01
items.description: A centered hero with an announcement badge, a two-line headline, two pill CTAs and a framed product window built from Blank components: sidebar, stat cards with bar sparklines, filter tabs and a live job table.

items.name: input-file
items.title: Input File
items.description: A drag-and-drop file field with previews, built on the native file input.

items.name: input-price
items.title: Input Price
items.description: A currency amount field that accepts only digits and a capped decimal.

items.name: interactive-hover-button
items.title: Interactive Hover Button
items.description: Blank's button with a dot that floods it on hover while the label slides back in with an arrow.

items.name: ipad-frame
items.title: iPad Frame
items.description: A tablet drawn in CSS with even bezels, in portrait or landscape through the orientation prop.

items.name: iphone-frame
items.title: iPhone Frame
items.description: A modern iPhone drawn in CSS: titanium rim, even bezels, Dynamic Island and side buttons, at true proportions at any width.

items.name: macbook-frame
items.title: MacBook Frame
items.description: An open laptop drawn in CSS (lid, hinge and base) around a 16:10 screen for screenshots or live UI.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: An endless horizontal or vertical strip of content with edge fade, reverse, pause on hover and a reduced-motion pause.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: A searchable multi-select built on cmdk, with badges in the field, grouped options, a create row and a selection limit.

items.name: noise-texture
items.title: Noise Texture
items.description: A static SVG film-grain overlay for flat fills and gradients.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Counts up to a number on a spring, with tabular digits.

items.name: orbiting-circles
items.title: Orbiting Circles
items.description: Children spaced on a circle that slowly turns, staying upright.

items.name: pricing-01
items.title: Pricing 01
items.description: Three pricing tiers with a monthly/yearly toggle on a sliding indicator, prices that roll digit by digit, and a highlighted middle plan.

items.name: pricing-card
items.title: Pricing Card
items.description: A plan card with a price, a feature list and a call to action.

items.name: progressive-blur
items.title: Progressive Blur
items.description: A blur that ramps up toward the edge of a scrolling container.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity Stepper
items.description: A number field with decrement and increment buttons, clamped to a range.

items.name: rating
items.title: Rating
items.description: A star rating with radio-group semantics, optional half values and a read-only mode.

items.name: safari-frame
items.title: Safari Frame
items.description: macOS Safari window chrome (traffic lights, address field with lock and host, optional tab strip) around a viewport for screenshots, video or live UI.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Scrambles text into random characters and resolves it left to right.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A hairline that fills as the page or a container scrolls.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: Blank's button with a spark of light travelling around its rim.

items.name: shiny-text
items.title: Shiny Text
items.description: Muted text with a highlight sweeping across it.

items.name: snippet
items.title: Snippet
items.description: An install command with package-manager tabs and a copy button.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card whose border and surface light up under the cursor, colored from the brand and border tokens.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Numbered steps for a multi-part flow, horizontal or vertical, with completed, active, loading and disabled states.

items.name: tags-input
items.title: Tags Input
items.description: A text field that turns entries into removable tags: Enter or comma adds, Backspace removes, paste splits.

items.name: terminal-window
items.title: Terminal Window
items.description: Terminal chrome with a title bar, prompt-led command lines, coloured output lines and an optional typing animation.

items.name: text-animate
items.title: Text Animate
items.description: Reveals text by word, character or line with ten motion presets.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that tilts toward the pointer with a following glare; off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: A segmented time field: hours, minutes, optional seconds and AM/PM, each a keyboard-steppable spin button.

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: A vertical or horizontal sequence of dated events with indicators, titles and content.

items.name: tracker
items.title: Tracker
items.description: An uptime strip of status blocks with tooltips and keyboard navigation.

items.name: typing-animation
items.title: Typing Animation
items.description: Types text out character by character, or cycles through several strings.

items.name: word-rotate
items.title: Word Rotate
items.description: Cycles through a list of words in place without moving the text around it.
